nodes.name: 🔗 Webhook: Lead Intake
nodes.description: Entry point. Accepts POST /lead-intake. Fast-ack pattern: response is sent immediately via Respond to Webhook node, processing continues async.

nodes.name: ✅ ACK: Immediate 202 Response
nodes.description: Returns HTTP 202 immediately so the caller is not blocked. Pipeline continues processing asynchronously.

nodes.name: 🛡️ Validate + Spam Filter
nodes.description: Validates required fields, email format, message length. Computes spam score from keyword matching, repeated chars, suspicious domains. Score ≥50 = spam.

nodes.name: 🔀 Route: Valid or Dead-Letter?
nodes.description: Branches: TRUE → valid lead continues pipeline | FALSE → dead-letter flow

nodes.name: 🔑 Generate Idempotency Hash
nodes.description: Computes SHA-256(email|message|product). This idempotency key is used to prevent duplicate processing. Same payload = same hash = skip.

nodes.name: 🔍 Check: Already Processed? (Sheets Lookup)
nodes.description: Looks up the idempotency key in the Leads sheet. If found → duplicate. If not found → new lead.

nodes.name: 🔀 Route: New Lead or Duplicate?
nodes.description: TRUE = idempotency_key not found = new lead → continue | FALSE = duplicate found → skip and log

nodes.name: 📋 Log: Duplicate Ignored
nodes.description: Structured log of the duplicate event. Pipeline terminates here. No record is written. Idempotency guarantee is preserved.

nodes.name: 🧠 Enrich: Company + Priority Score + Tags
nodes.description: Infers company from email domain (known mappings + heuristic). Computes priority score (0-100) from urgency, keywords, company tier, message depth. Assigns classification tags.

nodes.name: 📊 Log: Enrichment Observability
nodes.description: Emits a structured JSON log entry after enrichment. Enables log aggregation (Datadog, CloudWatch, Loki) for observability dashboards.

nodes.name: 💾 Store: Google Sheets — Leads
nodes.description: Persists lead with all enriched fields, idempotency key, status, and metadata to the Leads sheet.

nodes.name: 🔀 Route: High Urgency or Normal?
nodes.description: TRUE = urgency:high → Slack alert + Jira ticket | FALSE = normal → email confirmation

text.text: 🚨 HIGH URGENCY LEAD — Immediate Action Required

nodes.name: 📢 Slack: High Urgency Alert
nodes.description: Sends structured Block Kit Slack alert to the support channel for high-urgency leads. Includes all key fields and idempotency key.

nodes.name: 🎫 Jira: Create High-Priority Ticket
nodes.description: Creates a Jira issue via REST API with full lead details, priority score, and enrichment tags. Requires JIRA_BASE_URL and JIRA_PROJECT_KEY env vars.

nodes.name: 📧 Email: Confirmation (Normal Urgency)
nodes.description: Sends a formatted HTML confirmation email for normal-urgency leads. Includes reference ID (first 16 chars of idempotency hash).

nodes.name: ✏️ Update Status: acknowledged
nodes.description: Updates the record's status to 'acknowledged' after confirmation email is sent.

nodes.name: 📋 Audit Trail Log
nodes.description: Writes a structured audit trail entry for every successfully processed lead. Captures final routing decision and enrichment outcome.

nodes.name: ☠️ Dead-Letter: Prepare Payload
nodes.description: Prepares a structured dead-letter record from invalid/spam payloads. Captures original payload, failure stage, errors, and spam flags.

nodes.name: 💀 Dead-Letter: Store to DLQ Sheet
nodes.description: Appends failed/spam leads to the DeadLetterQueue sheet for manual review, re-processing, or analysis.

nodes.name: ⏰ Cron: Daily Digest at 6PM
nodes.description: Triggers daily at 18:00 (6PM) server time to compute and send the analytics digest.

nodes.name: 📥 Digest: Fetch All Leads
nodes.description: Fetches all rows from Leads sheet for today's digest computation.

nodes.name: 📊 Digest: Compute Analytics
nodes.description: Computes today's lead analytics: counts by urgency, breakdown by product, status distribution, average priority score, top 5 recent leads.

elements.text: Generated at {{ $json.generatedAt }} by Lead Pipeline Automation

nodes.name: 📢 Digest: Send to Slack
nodes.description: Sends the formatted daily analytics digest to Slack using Block Kit for structured rendering.

nodes.name: 🚨 Error Handler: Catch Runtime Failures
nodes.description: Catches any unhandled runtime errors from the main workflow. Formats them as dead-letter records for DLQ storage.

nodes.name: 💀 Error → DLQ Sheet
nodes.description: Persists runtime error records to DeadLetterQueue sheet. Same schema as validation failures for unified DLQ review.
